name: Nora Blake
style: Financial technology correspondent. Brisk, clear mid-register delivery with precise articulation of numbers and company names.

name: Simon Hale
style: Public affairs anchor. Measured bass-baritone, restrained emphasis and patient explanations of policy.

name: Eleanor West
style: Science desk editor. Warm alto with deliberate pauses around evidence and uncertainty.

name: Adrian Wells
style: Economics editor. Dry, rounded baritone, evenly paced, with authoritative but conversational explanations of figures.

name: Maeve Quinn
style: Arts correspondent. Expressive lower register, nimble phrasing, lively but grounded storytelling.

name: Ronan Bell
style: Sports journalist. Bright tenor, quick rhythmic delivery and crisp timing for scores and results.

name: Anika Das
style: Climate correspondent. Clear, even alto with a thoughtful cadence and precise scientific diction.

name: Dev Raman
style: Industry correspondent. Resonant medium register and steady explanatory pacing, careful with technical terms.

name: Camille Laurent
style: European affairs reporter. Cool, composed mid register with elegant phrasing and clear English diction.

name: Julien Perrin
style: Local and infrastructure reporter. Warm textured low register with conversational pacing and lucid place names.
